other_failure_modes.name: TfidfVectorizer Input Dimension Error in ColumnTransformer
other_failure_modes.description: Passing a single text column as a list (e.g., `["text_col"]`) to a TfidfVectorizer inside a ColumnTransformer causes it to receive a DataFrame instead of a 1D Series. The vectorizer then iterates over the column names rather than the rows, resulting in a 1-row output and a fatal array concatenation dimension mismatch. The agent catches this and falls back to dropping the text features entirely.

other_failure_modes.name: Incorrect Submission ID Format
other_failure_modes.description: The agent drops the original identifier column (`request_id`) and generates synthetic sequential IDs (`np.arange(n)`) for the submission file. This will cause the submission to fail downstream evaluation or be scored incorrectly because the predictions will not map to the original instances.

summary: The agent implements a reasonable feature engineering pipeline but makes a critical error by passing a DataFrame instead of a Series to TfidfVectorizer, causing a fatal dimension mismatch that forces a fallback discarding all TF-IDF features. Furthermore, the agent drops the original 'request_id' and writes sequential IDs to the submission file, which will break evaluation. Standard data science practices like chronological splitting and multiple model evaluations are also missing.
